name: Kung Long Batteries Industrial Co.,Ltd
summary: Kung Long Batteries Industrial Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries in Taiwan, Vietnam, Oceania, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, North America, and South America. The company offers valve-regulated lead-acid, lithium, and home and industrial storage batteries, as well as plastic products. Its products are used in various applications, including general purpose, electronic/security backup, IDC/UPS high rate, telecom, motive/HME mobility, renewable energy, starting power, and marine/RV-AGM dual purpose. Kung Long Batteries Industrial Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Nantou City, Taiwan.
